description: A shell script defining functions for IPv4 address manipulation, validation, conversion, and classification, along with some IP range constants.

methods.name: assert_uint32
methods.description: Validates that input is a decimal integer within 32-bit unsigned integer range.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set in a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: str2ip
methods.description: Converts dotted decimal IPv4 address string to a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer to dotted decimal IPv4 address string.

methods.name: prefix2netmask
methods.description: Converts a prefix length (0-32) to a network mask in integer form.

methods.name: is_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within the private RFC 1918 ranges.

methods.name: is_rfc3927
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within the link-local RFC 3927 range.

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: is_multicast
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a multicast address.

methods.name: _is_contiguous
methods.description: Internal function to check if bits are contiguous upper bits (used for netmask validation).

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if bits form a contiguous mask of upper bits.

methods.name: netmask2prefix
methods.description: Converts a netmask to prefix length after validation of contiguity.
